items.followUp: What is the difference between base and derived quantities? Give one example of each.

rubric.why: Identifies that base quantities are independent.
rubric.description: Base quantities are independent and are not defined in terms of other physical quantities.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that base quantities are independent or are not defined in terms of other physical quantities.

rubric.why: Explains how derived quantities are formed.
rubric.description: Derived quantities are obtained by combining base quantities.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that derived quantities are formed by combining base quantities.

modelAnswer: Base quantities are independent physical quantities; they are not defined in terms of other physical quantities.
Derived quantities are obtained by combining base quantities, for example, area and speed.

items.followUp: Define nuclear physics and state what it studies.

rubric.description: Atomic physics is the branch of physics that studies atoms and their properties.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying atomic physics as the study of atoms or their properties.

rubric.description: Nuclear physics is the branch of physics that studies atomic nuclei and their properties.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying nuclear physics as the study of atomic nuclei or their properties.

modelAnswer: Atomic physics is the branch of physics that studies atoms and their properties.
Nuclear physics is the branch of physics that studies atomic nuclei and their properties.

items.followUp: State Newton's Second Law of Motion.

rubric.why: States the motion states that remain unchanged in the absence of an unbalanced force.
rubric.description: A body remains at rest or continues in uniform motion in a straight line.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating both rest and uniform straight-line motion as unchanged states.

rubric.why: Identifies the condition that can change the body's state of motion.
rubric.description: The state of motion changes when an unbalanced external force acts on the body.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for specifying an unbalanced external force as the cause of a change in the body's state of motion.

modelAnswer: A body remains at rest or continues to move with uniform velocity in a straight line unless acted upon by an unbalanced external force.
